environment.secret_policy: Do not commit .env files or private credentials. Expo public variables are expected from the target runtime.

health.current_local_smoke: GET / against the static dist artifact
health.status: canonical /health must be implemented or mapped in the deployment target before it becomes a blocking smoke gate

rollout.strategy: PR-first artifact promotion; .github/workflows/release.yml builds a reviewable bundle but does not deploy live services
rollout.change_window: normal business hours until automated smoke and rollback are proven
abort_conditions: target runtime cannot serve the web shell
Firebase auth initialization fails for known-good public env
critical user journeys cannot load at smoke depth

rollback.mechanism: re-promote previous successful artifact or revert the release PR
rollback.required_confirmation: identify previous successful commit SHA or artifact before deploy
rollback.data_migration_policy: no schema or data migrations are part of this baseline
